name: PACIRA BIOSCIENCES

priced.reason: not a repriceable fcff name or no growth supplied

devils_advocate.strongest_counter: The strongest case for engaging rather than refusing is that a deal spread is itself a tradable, analysable proposition: 0.30% to an expected close inside three months is roughly 1.3% annualised, which is BELOW the risk-free rate, so the arbitrage is priced for certainty and an informed analyst could argue it is too tight given that the HSR waiting period has not yet run on a transaction that consolidates non-opioid pain management with Viatris' own fast-acting meloxicam programme — an overlap the acquirer's own press release advertises as 'synergistic'. If the antitrust risk is real, the correct verdict is 'rich', not 'no_model'.
devils_advocate.what_would_prove_it: The HSR outcome: expiry of the initial waiting period versus a second request, and the tender's initial expiration date and tendered percentage once the Schedule TO and SC 14D9 are filed (due within 15 business days of 2026-10-08).
devils_advocate.already_visible: Partially, and it cuts against the counter. The 8-K conditions the Offer on HSR expiry but imposes no antitrust-specific regulatory covenant that I read, and the complementarity Viatris describes is between an acute post-surgical injectable (EXPAREL), an intra-articular steroid (ZILRETTA) and an oral NSAID — adjacent rather than overlapping therapeutic forms, which is a weak Clayton Act theory. The market's 0.30% discount is the collective view of exactly that question and I have no better information than it does.
devils_advocate.unresolved: I cannot independently price the antitrust risk, and I did not read the Schedule TO or the SC 14D9 because neither has been filed yet. I also did not verify whether a go-shop or matching-rights provision exists, because no fair value turns on it: on either answer the name is not a free-cash-flow valuation.

what_changed: Everything. 8-K filed 2026-10-08 under items 1.01, 7.01 and 9.01 — the merger agreement itself — with EX-99.1 the joint Viatris/Pacira press release. Viatris acquires all outstanding shares at $36.50 cash; both boards approved; close expected by end of 2026 subject to regulatory review. The release discloses Pacira LTM revenue to 2026-06-30 of approximately $746 million and adjusted EBITDA of approximately $177 million, and names EXPAREL and ZILRETTA as the assets. Viatris says it will fund primarily from excess cash with the remainder from short-term borrowings. This 8-K is dated the same session as the screen's price date, so the entire +45.5% five-day move, the 6.8x volume and the 'filed an 8-K' signal are one event: the announcement.
consensus_case: There is no consensus about cash flows to steelman: the price is an administered number. On 2026-10-08 Pacira signed an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Viatris Inc. and Peach Purchaser Sub Inc. under which Purchaser will commence a cash tender offer, within no more than 15 business days, for all outstanding shares at $36.50 per share in cash, an aggregate equity value of $1.65 billion. At $36.39 the stock trades at a 0.30% DISCOUNT to the offer. That spread, not a growth rate, is what the market is pricing: roughly 0.3% over an expected close 'by the end of 2026', i.e. a market-implied probability of completion close to certainty, against the 8-K's stated conditions (a minimum of one share more than 50% tendered, HSR expiry, and a Section 251(h) DGCL back-end merger needing no shareholder vote).
base_case_rationale: I do not produce a base case. A company under a signed all-cash tender offer has no free-cash-flow valuation that the market is expressing; its price is the offer less a completion discount. Supplying a growth rate here would be answering a question nobody is asking.
key_risks: Deal break on HSR or on the minimum tender condition — downside to roughly the $25.20 pre-announcement close
The engine will keep pricing this name as a free-cash-flow opportunity, and keep ranking it in the cheapest decile of Health Care, every session until it delists
Holding past the close converts an equity position into cash at $36.50 with no further upside
watch_for: Schedule TO and SC 14D9 filings, due within 15 business days of 2026-10-08
HSR second request, which would widen the spread and is the only event that makes this name interesting again
An 8-K under items 2.01, 3.01 or 5.01 completing the merger and delisting the shares
